# Emily & Harrison

- [Emily](../character/emily.md) — Spouse of — [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) — married couple who reconciled · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P2](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him, shocking the neighborhood. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) brings home local gossip about the couple's past separation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who reveals his newly scrubbed home and prepares to explain why he and his wife had parted ways.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated over his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and how they have now reconciled. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets acquainted with Mrs. Harrison, who walks her back across the fields, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) chatting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden surrounded by friends, after which the wedding party sees them off at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to clean up the stone house with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) and later walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), experiencing a quiet moment of romantic awakening.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
